methods.statement: physical / visible ceiling area is calculated independently; no ceiling is assumed gypsum unless a source / project fact / versioned ceiling-finish method authorises it - otherwise MATERIAL = BY_SPEC / UNRESOLVED and the area is still published
dry internal floors: porcelain unless the project specification overrides

gypsum / decor area (m2), cornice (lm), cove light / cove profile (lm), plaster corner beads / profiles (lm), spatter dash (m2), door reveals (m2), window reveals (m2) and other finish profiles (lm) are separate BOQ items wherever source geometry supports them - never buried in plaster, paint or wall tile; opening deduction and reveal addition stay separate calculations

a defensible measured geometry (floor, ceiling, wall face, skirting path ...) is released even when the finish material is not source-proven; MEASURED GEOMETRY and MATERIAL AUTHORITY are kept apart; material = SOURCE / URBAN METHOD / BY_SPEC (unresolved) - an unknown material never blocks the area
no normal skirting in wet / service rooms with full-height wall tile

rebar weight = sum(count x length x kg/m) per bar set; NET_DESIGN_WEIGHT uses only bars the source / detail supports (cover and laps from the structural notes); PROCUREMENT_WEIGHT_INCL_LAPS adds laps where a continuous bar exceeds the 12 m stock length, splicing is permitted and no detail contradicts it; hooks / bends / stirrup closing only from an explicit detail, the structural notes or an adopted detailing standard - otherwise BLOCKED_DETAILING; never kg/m3

residential floor build-up (screed + finish) = 0.10 m when neither the source / detail nor a project owner fact establishes it; labelled URBAN_FALLBACK, never SOURCE; not used where the source contradicts it; overrideable per project and per floor
wet / service room floors: tiled finish (tile type by specification)

rule: a method is versioned, scope-limited and overrideable; it is never a project fact; a fallback is never labelled SOURCE
